knowledgeObjects.name: Typography System
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Give governing typography principles; report honestly that no typeface is final
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part III Ch.14 §12
governanceRules: A named font becomes permanent only after formal approval, licensing confirmation, and cross-format testing
validationRules: Must not invent or imply a named typeface exists

knowledgeObjects.name: Colour Philosophy
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Give the colour-layer governance rules and correctly-scoped category-colour exploration
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part III Ch.14 §13
governanceRules: Do not create permanent colour values from screenshots or generated images
validationRules: Category-colour list must never be presented as final/settled
knowledgeObjects.evidenceClassification: Verified (governance table) / exploratory (category-colour list, preserved not upgraded)

knowledgeObjects.name: Iconography & Graphic Language
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Give governing rules for the arrow motif and supporting iconography
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part III Ch.14 §14
governanceRules: Arrow's relationship to the wordmark must remain protected
validationRules: Avoid list must always accompany the Favour list

knowledgeObjects.name: Photography & Image Style
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Give photography principles and the Protection Rule
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part III Ch.14 §15
governanceRules: Never 'improve' a product visual by changing the real bottle, label, colour, size, or approved design
validationRules: Seven principles and table preserved together; Protection Rule never dropped

knowledgeObjects.name: Packaging Identity Principles
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Give identity-continuity rules for packaging, deferring production out of scope
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part III Ch.14 §16
governanceRules: Category variation must remain subordinate to fixed/protected elements

knowledgeObjects.name: Digital Brand Consistency
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Give required controls for digital-channel identity consistency
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part III Ch.14 §17
governanceRules: Digital motion must reinforce movement without reducing usability or accessibility
validationRules: 'Reusable components' control must be preserved as named, not generalized

knowledgeObjects.name: Marketplace Brand Consistency
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Give required controls for marketplace listings
knowledgeObjects.scope: §18 Marketplace Brand Consistency, complete, incl. Figure 4.1
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part III Ch.14 §18
governanceRules: No unrelated products in a single-product story
validationRules: Figure 4.1's six-stage chain reproduced in exact order

knowledgeObjects.name: Identity Change Control
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Give the exact logo/identity replacement procedure
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part III Ch.14, Identity Change Control
governanceRules: Step 7 (prevent old logo returning via templates/stored assets) is highest-risk
validationRules: All seven steps in original order, none merged

knowledgeObjects.name: Chapter Governance Summary
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Preserve the chapter's closing governance content
knowledgeObjects.scope: Common Mistakes, Best Practices, Action Checklist, Chapter Summary
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part III Ch.14 closing subsections
